fields.quote: Keep the bound, filter the error, double the delay
fields.rationale: Before and after both use `for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= retries; attempt++)`, so the inclusive bound is unchanged. After adds `if (!error.retryable || attempt === retries) throw error`, which filters retries. After requests `sleep(10 * 2 ** attempt)` instead of `sleep(10)`, so requested delays double each eligible attempt (10, 20, 40, …). Probe after.exhausted.delays is [10, 20] versus before.exhausted.delays [10, 10].

fields.quote: The updated loop preserves the attempt budget and awaits each send
fields.rationale: After keeps `attempt <= retries` and `return await send()`. Probe after.exhausted.calls is 3 when retries is 2; after.zeroBudget.calls is 1 when retries is 0. Those match before.

fields.quote: Starting at zero makes the inclusive bound allow one initial attempt plus the configured retries.
fields.rationale: Both functions start at attempt 0 and continue while attempt <= retries, so send runs retries + 1 times when every send rejects. Probe comment: 'retries counts extra attempts, not all attempts'. after.exhausted.calls is 3 for retries 2; after.zeroBudget.calls is 1 for retries 0.

fields.quote: Returning the awaited result stops the loop on success.
fields.rationale: Both functions `return await send()` inside try. A resolved send exits the function. Probe after.duplicate.result is "delivered" after the second send succeeds; no further calls.

fields.quote: The catch block now decides whether another attempt is eligible before requesting a delay
fields.rationale: After catch throws when `!error.retryable || attempt === retries`, then `await sleep(...)` only if that guard does not throw. Before only checked `attempt === retries`. Probe after.permanent has calls 1, delays [], error "permanent"; before.permanent has calls 2, delays [10], result "delivered".

fields.quote: A permanent error or exhausted budget throws immediately.
fields.rationale: After throws in catch without sleep when retryable is false or attempt === retries. Probe after.permanent: calls 1, delays [], error "permanent". Probe after.exhausted: calls 3, delays [10, 20] (no third delay), error "transient".

fields.quote: Otherwise, the requested delays grow as 10, 20, 40 milliseconds, and so on.
fields.rationale: After code is `await sleep(10 * 2 ** attempt)` with attempt 0, 1, 2, … so requested delays are 10, 20, 40, …. This is the function formula, not an overread of the two-delay exhaustion probe. Contract: delays are requested milliseconds, not wall-clock.

fields.quote: The exhaustion probe records three sends and delays of 10 and 20 milliseconds, versus 10 and 10 before.
fields.rationale: Exact probe-results.json: after.exhausted.calls is 3, after.exhausted.delays is [10, 20]; before.exhausted.delays is [10, 10]. Matches probe.mjs assertions.
